# mycellios

> Mycellios is an AI agent workspace with optional model connections and a distributed compute network.

Micos are user agents. Use a supported personal provider or the optional Mycellios provider with AI Credits. One Credit corresponds to one USD for paid top-ups. Managed pricing is the complete upstream cost plus a 4% service fee. Availability depends on account, models, tools and operator configuration.

Approved, independently verified contribution work can earn Credits. Connection time, animations and benchmarks do not imply earnings. Credits are not the proposed Spore token, cash payouts or a guaranteed return. Multi-host GPU performance and combined-memory execution are not established as general production capabilities; consult the evidence record.

Each public page below has a Markdown version linked beside it. Spanish guides are full translations, not a separate product. [Full reference](https://www.mycellios.com/llms-full.txt).

## Product, guides and comparisons

- [Mycellios — AI agents, your models & shared compute](https://www.mycellios.com/): Work with AI agents in one workspace. Connect your models or use Mycellios Credits, and contribute compatible compute to earn Credits for verified work. [Markdown](https://www.mycellios.com/index.md).
- [Live distributed AI network | mycellios](https://www.mycellios.com/network): Inspect the public mycellios network snapshot: connected workers, available models, and recorded inference activity when data is available. [Markdown](https://www.mycellios.com/network.md).
- [Contribute compute and earn AI Credits | Mycellios](https://www.mycellios.com/earn): Activate compatible compute from your Mycellios account. Earn AI Credits for approved, independently verified work and pause contribution whenever you choose. [Markdown](https://www.mycellios.com/earn.md).
- [Native package availability | mycellios](https://www.mycellios.com/downloads): Check which mycellios native packages are published for Windows, macOS, and Linux, or contribute from your browser without installing software. [Markdown](https://www.mycellios.com/downloads.md).
- [Browser contribution | Mycellios](https://www.mycellios.com/browser/): Connect a desktop, tablet, or phone browser to mycellios and contribute voluntary, measurable compute that you can pause anytime. [Markdown](https://www.mycellios.com/browser.md).
- [AI Credits, costs & pricing | Mycellios](https://www.mycellios.com/pricing): Understand Mycellios Credits and optional model providers. Estimate your own provider and hosting costs, and check current model prices before use. [Markdown](https://www.mycellios.com/pricing.md).
- [Compare AI agent apps | Mycellios](https://www.mycellios.com/compare): Compare Mycellios with other agent apps, with original guidance and current product sources. [Markdown](https://www.mycellios.com/compare.md).
- [Mycellios Stats — network observations](https://www.mycellios.com/stats): Inspect observed node capacity, models, jobs and persisted history from Mycellios's public coordinator. [Markdown](https://www.mycellios.com/stats.md).
- [Changelog & release notes | Mycellios](https://www.mycellios.com/changelog): Follow Mycellios Desktop and Agent updates, with dated release notes, improvements, fixes and links to the original publications. [Markdown](https://www.mycellios.com/changelog.md).
